shots.title: APPROACH
shots.caption: A small figure walks the valley toward a far light.

shots.title: PROFILE
shots.caption: Seen from the side, each foot holds its place on the rock.

shots.title: ONWARD
shots.caption: The word ONWARD stands behind the walker.

shots.title: VISTA
shots.caption: The camera lifts away; the light still waits on the horizon.
